newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Mahathir says MAS success rests on costs.
newsitem.headline: Mahathir says MAS success rests on costs.

text.p: The success of Malaysia Airline System Bhd (MAS) depends on its ability to control costs, Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad was quoted as saying by the national Bernama news agency on Thursday.
"...If we don't pay attention to the cost factor, we will suffer losses and the MAS' performance will deteriorate, and its plans to expand will never materialise," Mahathir said.
"The opportunity and potential for MAS to grow and become one of the largest airlines in the world is bright.

"But the opportunity will remain just an opportunity if we don't know or don't want to capitalise on it. However, I'm confident of the efficiency of all the MAS staff and what is needed is only the dedication and the pride in your own organisation as well as the desire to make it succeed," he said in dinner speech marking the airline's 50th anniversary on Wednesday night.
If MAS failed for any reason, it would be seen as a failure for the country, Mahathir was quoted as saying.
The privatised airline was acquired by Tajudin Ramli in 1994.
